CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hardware_fingerprints (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            gpu_family TEXT NOT NULL,
            vram_gb REAL NOT NULL,
            system_ram_gb INTEGER,
            os_platform TEXT
        )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_fingerprints (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            model_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            file_path TEXT UNIQUE,
            quantization TEXT,
            architecture_type TEXT,
            expert_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            parameters_billions REAL
        )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS benchmark_runs (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            hardware_id INTEGER REFERENCES hardware_fingerprints(id),
            model_id INTEGER REFERENCES model_fingerprints(id),
            flags_used TEXT,
            context_lengths_tested TEXT,
            raw_metrics TEXT,
            oom_boundary INTEGER,
            oom INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            benchmark_suite_version TEXT,
            llama_server_version TEXT
        )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_benchmarks_hardware ON benchmark_runs(hardware_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_benchmarks_model ON benchmark_runs(model_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_benchmarks_timestamp ON benchmark_runs(timestamp)
ALTER TABLE benchmark_runs ADD COLUMN parsed_flags TEXT
ALTER TABLE benchmark_runs ADD COLUMN llama_server_version TEXT
